description:
Make `jit profile diff` and `jit profile apply` list every file an application writes.

## Background

Found while testing c780514e's 14c08f51 on an unseeded copy of this repository. `jit profile apply` rewrites `.jit/schemas/default-namespace-registry.json`, and neither the `diff` nor the `apply` report lists that file.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every file an application writes appears in the `diff` report and the `apply` report, or the issue records why that file is outside what they report.
title: Profile reports list every file an application writes
